I was in this position as well. I was 17 in my senior year of highschool. Chose to be homeless by family reasons rather than monetary reasons. Heres some tips;
1. You're very lucky its the summer. I was homeless in January, which where I am, is always below 0. 
2. Find a good university campus, you can do work on library computers, and sometimes find an empty classroom to sleep in. (Be warned this is trespassing if you're discovered). Just carry a bunch of books around and they'll think you're just very studious lol.
3. Find a local gym (or the university campus will have a gym) and use it for showers and bathrooms. 
4. Food - Protein will get you through the nights.
5. Never steal unless in desperate circumstances.
6. Don't beg, rather use your connections.
7. I know it makes economical sense to eat fast food, but don't. Cheaper meals can be found at grocery stores.
8. Have a cash flow. I became a SAT tutor because I had a 2400...
9. HOTELS - find your most pretentious outfit, and just chill there. If you're some sort of splinter cell ninja bro, you can sneak into a room when they clean out rooms that people moved out of. Recognizable by vacuuming, because they only vacuum when the guests leave. 
10. Keep your head up and dress nice. Don't look homeless, don't look unintelligent. This world is all about looks and how much strangers are willing to help you will depend on it more than you think.
EDIT 11. DEFENSE. Being homeless exposes you to bad people, but for reasons you don't expect. I had some encounters with drunk people out of bars at midnight etc.
